steps.title: Preview the recovery path
steps.expected: Preview only; no restore action is applied

steps.title: Validate installed files, assets, and services
Connect all five controllers before launching Carla
steps.action: Connect the Arturia, SMK-25, SMC-Mixer, SMC-PAD, and SMC-PAD Pocket and confirm their protected hardware presets.
steps.expected: One Arturia and four M-VAVE controllers are present

steps.title: Launch the protected Carla rack once
steps.expected: Carla opens /c/music/carla/pedro.uproject and finishes loading 49 plugins

steps.title: Validate controllers, Carla, services, quantum, and graph
steps.expected: Validation complete: 0 failures; Patchbay check remains dry-run

steps.title: Verify Arturia rack controls
steps.action: Play keys, move the central CC114 encoder, and press/release CC115 once; confirm volume tracking and click-free stereo mute.
steps.expected: Instruments play; rack volume and mute respond without an audible click

steps.title: Verify SMK-25 layers
steps.action: Toggle one Side-A layer, play and release a chord, then use Stop and Play.
steps.expected: Layer latch, chord replacement, pause, and resume match the protected behavior

steps.title: Verify SMC-Mixer equalizer
steps.action: Move faders 1 through 8 one at a time.
steps.expected: Only the corresponding protected equalizer band changes

steps.title: Verify SMC-PAD drums
steps.action: Play representative kick, snare, and cymbal pads.
steps.expected: The protected drum instrument responds at the expected level

steps.title: Verify SMC-PAD Pocket drums
steps.action: Play representative kick, snare, and cymbal pads.
steps.expected: The protected drum instrument responds independently at the expected level

steps.title: Verify audible stability
steps.action: Play the rack normally for at least two minutes while exercising the five controllers.
steps.expected: No dropout, stuck note, unintended route, or audible click is observed
